summary: QA fixes: PIN session persistence, dark mode header tokens, patient dropdown overflow & ARIA, mobile nav labels, Quick Start dialog description, changelog formatting, contact mailto links. PIN gate reworded as screen lock.
changes: PIN session persistence — unlock state now survives page reload via sessionStorage; deep-link redirects preserve original route.
Dark mode header — header bar now uses theme token; no more light-blue residue in dark mode.
Patient dropdown overflow — popover capped at max-h-80 with overflow scroll for 44+ patient lists.
Patient list ARIA tree — all patient options are DOM descendants of the listbox.
Mobile nav accessibility — all icon-only nav buttons now carry aria-label attributes.
Quick Start dialog — added DialogDescription for proper aria-describedby.
Contact page — email addresses are now clickable mailto: links with visible focus rings.
PIN gate reworded to Screen Lock with clarifying footnote about security boundaries.
Empty trailing parentheses removed from changelog header.

summary: Print pagination, report timestamps, redacted view toggle, redact context provider, unit test expansion, and technical debt cleanup.
changes: Print pagination — CSS page-break rules prevent orphaned headings and split AVOID entries across pages.
Report generation timestamps — footer on all three report types shows when the report was saved (not when viewed).
Redacted view toggle — EyeOff button replaces patient identifiers with ——— for demos and training; ephemeral, print always shows full data.
Redact context provider — useRedact hook provides redact() across all report components and text export functions.
Controls empty state — Clinical Report shows No controls recorded. when all control values are empty.
ResearchDrugResult type consolidated — idt_100, idt_10, idt_neat fields merged into single idt_results string.
Unit tests for testingUtils — all 5 exports covered (isSkinTestPositive, getPositiveResults, getNegativeResults, getCrossSensitizationNotes, buildRecommendations).
Unit tests for deidentify — 15 test cases covering name stripping, REDCap passthrough, challenge handling, legacy IDT fields, custom drug names.

summary: eMR letter rewrite, tryptase & cross-sensitization support, REDCap testing-plan parity, and 6-hour report retention.
changes: Tryptase paragraph — testing form now captures tryptase samples; eMR letter auto-generates the correct clinical sentence (not obtained / not elevated / significant elevation).
Roc/Vec cross-sensitization — positive Rocuronium or Vecuronium automatically adds a cross-sensitization note and AVOID entry for the related drug.

Recommendations restructured — eMR letter and clinical report now lead with bold AVOID lines per positive drug, followed by standardised action bullets (eMR update, GP/MyHealth, MedicAlert for muscle relaxants, patient letter copy).
Nursing Notes — new collapsible section in the testing form for pre/during/post-testing observations and nurse sign-off; appears in clinical report only.
IV challenge now in eMR letter — drug challenge outcome renders as a dedicated block in the PowerChart letter.
REDCap testing-plan parity — app reads the explicit testing-plan instrument checkboxes from the CSV instead of inferring drugs from the reaction history.
6-hour report retention — active report survives an accidental exit; banner on the log screen lets you reopen or clear it within 6 hours.
eMR letter simplified — SPT/IDT measurements removed from the PowerChart letter; drug names only (full data stays in the clinical report).
Sugammadex fixed — you can now select both 'Alone' and '+ Rocuronium' at the same time without one cancelling the other.
Propofol simplified — collapsed from two testing protocols to a single IV protocol, removed unnecessary IDT dilution.
Parecoxib streamlined — removed extra IDT dilution step that was no longer needed.
Contact phone number updated.
Drug plan now carries over to testing — drugs selected in the testing plan automatically populate the testing panel.
Print improvements — browser headers and footers (URLs, dates, page numbers) no longer appear when printing reports.
Empty result fields now show a dash placeholder correctly on all browsers.
Toast notifications cleaned up — removed rounded corners for a consistent clinical look.
Print background fixed — reports now print with a clean white background.
Print section headers improved — removed gray backgrounds that looked messy when printed.
Signature lines improved — better layout with writing space above the line.
Multi-sample tryptase support — patients can now have multiple tryptase readings recorded with clinical timestamps (acute, 1-hour, 24-hour, and custom).
Tryptase results display updated — all samples shown in chronological order in the reaction summary.
REDCap CSV parsing improved — drug columns no longer incorrectly include non-drug fields such as anaesthesia type or adrenaline administration route.
REDCap CSV parsing fixed — patient reaction comments now map to the correct column instead of the treatment notes column.
REDCap CSV parsing fixed — referring doctor position field now imports correctly from the CSV export.
